conviction_note: The evidence nets to a small positive: management's implied Q4 looks conservative after Q3, insiders bought in August, and FY27 free cash flow loses about $40M of one-time costs. Against that, the FY27 EPS bar (~$1.80) sits above the Q4 run-rate the company itself implies, and the US insulin market kept shrinking through July-September. So p_up is 51 on an 18-point absolute move. That move is a heavily levered equity stub (~$335M market cap against ~$1.24B net debt) receiving its first FY27 guide, with options implying 20%. The findings sum (+0.8) and the scaled number (+0.36) agree in sign and are both near zero. The direction is genuinely open, and the size of the move is the confident part.
bar: Q4 FY26 (Jul-Sep 2026). The company's guide implies revenue $260-280M: FY $1,015-1,035M less 9M $754.7M (Q1 $261.2M, Q2 $221.8M, Q3 $271.7M). It implies adjusted EPS $0.26-0.36: FY $1.80-1.90 less 9M $1.54 (Q1 $0.71, Q2 $0.27, Q3 $0.56). Sources: Q3 8-K ex-99.1 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001872789/000187278926000029/q32026ex-991.htm and Q2 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001872789/000187278926000014/q22026ex-991.htm. Street: Benzinga $0.29 / $269.7M, Chartmill $0.30 / $275.1M (6 analysts on FY26, Q4 revenue estimate revised down 3.5% in 3 months), so the Street sits at or slightly below the guide midpoint. FY27, the bar the stock most likely trades on: WallStreetZen shows EPS $1.80 (range $1.72-1.86, 6 analysts) and revenue ~$1.10B (+8.3%) (https://www.wallstreetzen.com/stocks/us/nasdaq/embc/stock-forecast). That is a single source, so the FY27 findings are capped small. Price targets $3-5, mean $4, Hold; BTIG Hold reiterated 2026-10-09, BofA Sell 2026-08-10 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/embc/forecast/).

findings.finding: The FY26 guide implies Q4 adjusted EPS of only $0.26-0.36 ($1.80-1.90 less 9M $1.54), against Q3's actual $0.56. Q4 also carries a full quarter of Owen Mumford, which added $13.8M in half of Q3, and laps Q4 FY25 revenue of $263.3M, a quarter in which US revenue had already fallen 15% cc. The Street's Q4 $0.29-0.30 / $270-275M sits at or below the guide midpoint, so a beat on the reported quarter is the base case unless Q3 held a timing benefit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mixed. Q3 FY26 EPS $0.56 vs $0.27 consensus, revenue $271.7M vs $254.5M, with an EPS raise: +26.3%. Q1 FY26 EPS beat (+6%) with revenue guided to the low end: -7.75%. Q4 FY25 EPS beat ($0.50 vs $0.46) with a small revenue miss and a weak FY26 guide: -7.24% (https://www.tikr.com/blog/why-embecta-nasdaq-embc-stock-is-down-20-this-week). Beats are not bought unless the guide cooperates.
findings.why_not_priced: The Street's Q4 EPS ($0.29-0.30) simply sits on the low half of the company's implied range rather than on Q3's run-rate. Chartmill shows the Q4 revenue estimate revised down 3.5% in three months even after a $17M Q3 revenue beat. If the market priced a Q3-like Q4, estimates would sit near $0.40+.
findings.independence: Street figures: Benzinga $0.29 / $269.7M and Chartmill $0.30 / $275.1M, via search snippet (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/EMBC/earnings-forecasts). The Q3 beat size is from https://drugdeliverybusiness.com/embecta-q3-results-beat-analyst-expectations/. This shares the Q3 8-K with the FY27-bar finding, which reads the same Q4-implied arithmetic as a risk to FY27 rather than as conservatism. The two can both be true: a Q4 beat and a cautious FY27 guide.

findings.finding: Four insiders bought shares in the open market on 2026-08-12, five days after Q3 and before FY27 planning: CEO Kurdikar 30,000 at $4.70, CFO Elguicze 20,000 at $4.67, CLO Mann 20,000 at $4.99 and director Hombach 45,000 at $4.97, about $560k in total. The only insider sale since is director Mayo, 6,293 shares at $5.875 on 2026-09-04.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior insider-buy cluster to compare. The stock is now $5.725, above every insider's purchase price, having been as high as $6.43 on 2026-11-10.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, so it is partly priced, but it is an August signal on a name covered by 4-6 analysts with Hold/Sell ratings and $3-5 targets, all below spot. If the market had read it as guide-confidence, targets would have moved off the post-May $3-5 band, and the 20-day run-up would not be -16% into the print.
findings.independence: Same filer set: CFO https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1872789/000094787126000788/xslF345X06/ownership.xml, CLO https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1872789/000094787126000787/xslF345X06/ownership.xml, director https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1872789/000094787126000786/xslF345X06/ownership.xml. findings.finding: FY27 free cash flow loses one-time costs. Management said FY26 FCF of about $100M includes about $40M of one-time costs (about $30M for the brand transition), and the brand transition is substantially complete by the end of calendar 2026. A preliminary FY27 cash framework near $120M+ would be over a third of the ~$335M market cap. FCF was $87.9M for 9M FY26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history. FCF and deleveraging were the stated priorities after the May 2026 reset, and the May print (-57.8%) was driven by the EPS/margin cut, not by cash.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades at about 3x FCF on an EV of about $1.58B, where the equity is a small stub. Sell-side targets of $3-5 sit below spot, which suggests the street models FCF through EPS, which is still falling, rather than through cash. A guide that leads with cash would be visible as a re-rating. Not having one is consistent with the -16% 20-day drift.
findings.independence: Q3 8-K: 9M FCF $87.9M, brand transition substantially complete by end of calendar 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001872789/000187278926000029/q32026ex-991.htm). Finsee: FY26 FCF guide unchanged at about $100M, FY26 interest about $95M (https://finsee.ai/earnings/embc/2026/q3/en/). Capped small because whether the company guides FCF at all on 11-24 is unknown.

findings.finding: The FY27 consensus of about $1.80 EPS on about $1.10B revenue sits well above the Q4 run-rate the company's own guide implies ($0.31 midpoint x 4 = $1.24), though below Q3's ($0.56 x 4). Structural headwinds feed straight into a first FY27 guide: price was -$27.4M and volume -$60.0M in 9M pen needles, the company is launching lower-priced pen needles and syringes, cannula costs are sole-sourced, interest runs about $95M a year, and Q1 FY27 laps a pre-share-loss US quarter. This is from a management that guided FY26 at $2.80-3.00 and cut it by 45%, and that said in May it assumes current conditions persist.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The first-guide print sold off: November 2025 initial FY26 guide (flat to -2% cc, margin down 180bp) gave -7.24% close-to-close, and over 12% intraday per Tikr. The May 2026 guide cut gave -57.8%. The August 2026 EPS raise gave +26.3%. Guidance is the line this stock trades on, in both directions.
findings.why_not_priced: The FY27 EPS range of $1.72-1.86 is tight, which suggests analysts have extrapolated an average of Q3 and Q4 plus full-year Owen Mumford, not a conservative reset. If the market expected a guide below $1.72, the stock at about 3x FCF would be lower still, and the call-heavy open interest (put/call 0.08) would not lean up. This is capped small because the FY27 bar has a single source.
findings.independence: Pricing and volume bridge in the Q3 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001872789/000187278926000029/q32026ex-991.htm). Management's 'assume current conditions persist' and 'not providing FY27 guidance' are from the BofA event (https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/healthcare/articles/embecta-faces-u-reset-ceo-160612066.html). This shares the Q4-implied arithmetic with the reported-quarter finding.

findings.finding: Novo Nordisk's Q3 2026 6-K (July-September, the same months as Embecta's FQ4) says US insulin sales fell 13% at CER, 'mainly driven by loss of market share, a declining insulin market' and lower realised prices; 9M was -16%. The US insulin pen market that pulls Embecta's US pen needles was still shrinking into the quarter being reported and the FY27 base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The May 2026 collapse (-57.8%) was attributed partly to softer insulin pen scripts. The CEO calls insulin pen scripts the leading indicator for the business.
findings.why_not_priced: Novo spoke after Embecta last did (2026-08-07) and has no direct link to EMBC in the coverage. If priced, Embecta's FY27 revenue consensus would not need roughly flat organic US. This is a proxy: Novo's decline includes its own share loss, and Embecta's May guide already assumed soft conditions persist, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The CEO's own statement that insulin pen scripts had recently declined, mainly in retail, and that retail pen needle declines exceed insulin pen declines (https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/healthcare/articles/embecta-faces-u-reset-ceo-160612066.html, 2026-05-16).

findings.finding: openFDA's 510(k) database shows embecta's only 2026 clearance as K260208, the Ultra-Fine SAFETY insulin syringe (2026-07-13). No clearance appears for the lower-priced 'market-appropriate' pen needle that the Q3 release says is under FDA review. That product is the company's stated answer to the price-driven US retailer share loss, so a US recapture is unlikely to be in the FY27 guide's first half.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. Product clearances have not been a print driver for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody aggregates it. It is small because the database lags by weeks, and the company may announce a clearance on the call.
findings.independence: The Q3 8-K lists the pen needle as under review with FDA and BSI (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001872789/000187278926000029/q32026ex-991.htm). The CEO said price was 'the single largest factor' in the retailer loss (Yahoo, 2026-05-16).

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August 2026 print with an EPS raise produced +26.3% on a similarly short-heavy register.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is itself the market's view, so this is an amplifier, not an edge. It is sized small.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with (null), and listed open interest is call-heavy. The -16% 20-day run-up into a first FY27 guide on a stock that fell 58% on its last guide reset is compatible with either side. My near-zero lean neither fights nor follows the tape; the realised size is where the baseline speaks (20% implied).
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6: the Q4 reported-quarter finding cut from +1.5 to +1.0. Beats on this name have been sold twice when the guide disappointed, and the Q4 bar sits inside the company's implied range.
Lesson 6 (bar single-sourced): the FY27 consensus has one source, so the two FY27 guidance findings were capped. The FY27-bar negative went from -1.5 to -1.0 and the FCF positive from +1.0 to +0.7.

Lesson 5 (proxy): the Novo US-insulin finding was kept but cut from -1.0 to -0.7, as a counterparty proxy partly inside the company's 'conditions persist' guide. The FDA-database absence was cut from -0.5 to -0.3.
Lesson 7 / lesson 5 on positioning: the short-interest finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3, because positioning is an amplifier, not an edge.
Lesson 8: abs_move_pct raised from 17 to 18 for a thin-coverage name getting a first FY27 guide. Insider-buy finding trimmed from +1.0 to +0.8 as public since August.
